There’s always baggage.
Integrated Marketing Campaign Speculative

The brief

Nere already had the product, the colour and the travel identity. The opportunity was not to redesign the suitcase. It was to find more moments for the marketing to matter.

Objective

Increase consideration among younger Australian travellers by making Nere more present around the moments when travel becomes real.

The moments when luggage matters most are rarely the glamorous parts of travelling.

There’s always baggage.

Baggage claim

The reveal moment: a belt of identical black cases, and one that is unmistakably yours.

Airport scale

Contextual advertising places Nere in moments where travellers are already thinking about their luggage.

Packing

Creator content uses familiar packing formats and lets the reality gradually interrupt them.

Somehow it all has to come home.

Retail

Retail merchandising translates suitcase sizes into recognisable travel occasions, making the decision easier to understand.

A physical campaign extension designed to travel with the luggage itself.

Digital & performance strategy

Search→ Packing guide→ Find your size→ Product→ Retargeting

Performance marketing is functional. It does not need to force the campaign tagline into every touchpoint.

How the campaign connects

Airport / OOH
Social / Creator
Search
Retail
CRM Activation

One connected marketing system, not five separate ones.

The thinking behind the campaign system.
